name: usage-guard
description: Pause Claude before its next tool call when your 5-hour or weekly plan usage runs hot with lots of window left, and resume when you reply. Hooks only, zero tokens until it fires; needs a short status line snippet to see usage.

five_hour_pct.title: 5-hour trigger (%)
five_hour_pct.description: Pause when 5-hour plan usage is at or above this percentage.

min_left_min.title: 5-hour minimum time left (minutes)
min_left_min.description: Only pause if at least this many minutes remain before the 5-hour window resets.

seven_day_pct.title: Weekly trigger (%)
seven_day_pct.description: Pause when weekly plan usage is at or above this percentage. 0 disables the weekly check.

weekly_min_left_hours.title: Weekly minimum time left (hours)
weekly_min_left_hours.description: Only pause if at least this many hours remain before the weekly window resets.

snapshot_path.title: Usage snapshot file
snapshot_path.description: File your status line writes plan usage to (see the README). A leading ~/ means your home directory.

stale_after_sec.title: Snapshot max age (seconds)
stale_after_sec.description: Ignore a snapshot older than this, so stale data never causes a pause.
